lanes.purpose: Issuer/customer/supplier disclosures for orders, backlog, pricing and capacity.
lanes.limitations: Focused on global companies surfaced by generic change searches; not every listed issuer was crawled.

lanes.purpose: Survey/market data on shortages, inventories, prices, utilization and lead times.
lanes.limitations: Uses accessible survey data; many proprietary commodity/industry datasets remain unavailable.

lanes.purpose: Attributed reporting for early economic changes and cross-source confirmation.
lanes.limitations: Coverage concentrated on accessible Reuters historical reports.

lanes.purpose: Domain-specialist data for semiconductor/memory supply-demand conditions.
lanes.limitations: Focused on accessible TrendForce summaries; paywalled detail may be incomplete.

eventClusters.statement: Conventional and server memory supply tightened sharply in Q4 2025 as AI/CSP demand rose and suppliers prioritized higher-value capacity, driving broad DRAM/NAND pricing power.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Check whether price increases reflect temporary panic buying versus persistent capacity allocation and end demand.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share companies have material direct memory pricing exposure versus merely higher input costs?

eventClusters.statement: Power and electrification equipment backlogs accelerated, including gas-turbine contractual commitments and grid-equipment backlog, indicating multi-quarter equipment scarcity and demand.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Separate gas-turbine-specific scarcity from broad grid equipment; avoid assuming all power-equipment suppliers benefit equally.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which listed suppliers have verified product/geographic overlap with the constrained equipment categories?

eventClusters.statement: Reported foundry price increases for 2026 may raise advanced-chip input costs and/or foundry pricing power.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: No independent first-party/industry confirmation is frozen in this pack.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can the reported foundry price change be independently verified and mapped to A-share earnings?

eventClusters.statement: AI-related data retention may be creating HDD/NVMe demand pressure and backlog.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Only community evidence is frozen; verify with manufacturer shipments/backlog before mapping.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is the storage-hardware backlog observable in first-party manufacturer results?

eventClusters.statement: Copper prices reached record levels amid mine-supply constraints, while substitution risk increased as users considered aluminum and alternative designs.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Demand-growth uncertainty and substitution can cap upside; separate upstream miners from processors hurt by higher input costs.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share copper exposures have upstream operating leverage not already fully reflected in expectations?

eventClusters.statement: Community discussion claims falling battery costs are improving solar-plus-storage economics and grid flexibility.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The frozen pack lacks a Q4 independent battery-cost dataset supporting the magnitude claim.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is the cost decline independently measurable and material to storage project IRRs?

eventClusters.statement: AI/data-center buildout translated into accelerating real orders for electrification, motion/power systems and grid equipment rather than remaining only a capex narrative.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Need to distinguish broad industry order growth from specific A-share customer/product qualification and avoid double-counting generic AI-power beta.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share power-equipment firms show direct data-center orders/revenue with valuation not already saturated?

eventClusters.statement: Rare-earth/germanium and semiconductor-related input shortages worsened across European electronics, electrical equipment and automotive manufacturing during Q4 2025.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Shortage can hurt downstream users while helping upstream processors; export policy and substitution can change the sign of exposure.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Are there A-share upstream suppliers with verified export/price leverage rather than downstream cost exposure?

eventClusters.statement: China solar additions remained extremely high and October installations recovered after a mid-year policy-driven slowdown, while grid investment also increased.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: High installations do not imply high module profitability; policy transition and overcapacity may keep upstream/downstream economics divergent.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which parts of the solar/grid chain gain earnings rather than only shipment volume?
